Auto svg conversion with accessible names disabled

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert_with_accessible_names("<p><svg aria-label=\"Name\"><text>Drawn</text></svg></p>", false, "{\"inline_data_media\":\"AltTextOnly\",\"tier_strategy\":\"auto\"}");

    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});
```
